title: Onboarding dialog displays obsolete v1 mechanics and covers first-time class picker
steps: Start with clean browser storage (empty localStorage).
Open http://localhost:4174/ (Cat RPG v2 demo mode).
expected: The user is greeted with a v2-appropriate introduction explaining how to choose a class and start playing the stage layout, or the ClassPicker is presented cleanly without obsolete v1 dialogs.
actual: The HowToPlay modal dialog automatically opens with a full-screen backdrop, obscuring the ClassPicker. The dialog lists legacy v1 strings: 'strip' instead of stage, earning 'Gold and Shards' instead of Fish and Yarn, 'Beat the boss to earn one Boss Key per day (3 fights a day)', 'Spend Gold on gear upgrades in Inventory', 'Forge a Relic with 10 Shards and 1 Boss Key', and 'Trade in Market', which are completely inaccurate in v2.

title: ClassPicker confirmation box keyboard focus trap skips Confirm and Cancel buttons
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:4174/ with empty localStorage.
Close or bypass the onboarding modal.
Use keyboard Tab to reach the 'Choose <Class>' button in ClassPicker footer.
Press Enter or Space to activate the button and open the confirmation box.
Press Tab to advance to the newly appeared Confirm button.
expected: Focus shifts to the 'Confirm' button inside the confirmation box, or Tab advances through Confirm and Cancel before moving outside.
actual: Focus remains on the 'Choose <Class>' button. The confirmation box is inserted before the footer in DOM tree order, so pressing Tab advances forward to the character slots below the picker, completely bypassing Confirm and Cancel. Keyboard-only users cannot easily confirm their choice without backward Shift-Tabbing.

title: No Unequip button or interaction available in character slots or bag UI
steps: Equip any item into an equipment slot.
Attempt to unequip the item to leave the slot empty.
expected: Clicking the equipped item in CharacterPanel or selecting it in Bag provides an 'Unequip' action to return the item to the bag and leave the slot empty.
actual: No Unequip option exists. BagPanel filters out all equipped items (showing only unequipped items in the bag), and CharacterPanel SlotButton click handlers are inert because StageLayout does not provide onSelectSlot. Equipped items can only be replaced by equipping another item in the same slot, never removed.

title: Threshold mismatch between StageLayout and WelcomeBack silences away loot feedback
steps: Play the game, then leave the tab in the background for 60 to 299 seconds (1 to 4 minutes).
Return to the tab to trigger the away claim.
expected: A WelcomeBack popup or a 'Recent finds' summary banner appears indicating how much Fish, Yarn, XP, and materials were earned while away.
actual: StageLayout flags welcome=true because awayRef.current >= 60. However, WelcomeBack returns null because its internal visibility guard requires awaySeconds >= 300 (5 minutes). Furthermore, StageLayout suppresses the fallback LootSummary component whenever welcome is true ({gains && !welcome && <LootSummary ... />}), resulting in zero visual feedback about claimed loot.

title: Class switching promised in UI is inaccessible after initial class confirmation
steps: On fresh start, read ClassPicker subtitle: 'Select a feline combat specialization. You can switch your class any time outside boss fights.'
Confirm class selection to begin exploring.
Look for any UI element, tab, header button, or menu option to change class.
expected: A button or settings option allows the player to open ClassPicker and change their class outside of boss fights, as promised by the UI text.
actual: StageLayout only mounts ClassPicker when state.cat.classId is null ({state && !classId && <ClassPicker ... />}). Once a class is selected, ClassPicker is permanently unmounted and no button or control exists to invoke class switching without manually clearing localStorage.

title: Idle loop combat montage only animates on claim resolution rather than continuous combat
steps: Watch the cat and monster on the stage during the 30-second idle period.
Observe movement and HUD counters between claims.
expected: The cat and monster engage in continuous idle combat with numbers smoothly ticking up, or a clear progress bar indicates countdown to the next combat resolution.
actual: Cat and monster walk in place continuously. Combat montage only plays briefly when a 30-second claim completes. Between claims, HUD counters do not increment.

title: Race condition between claim timer and user actions in loopV2
steps: Perform an action (such as craft, salvage, equip, or forgeRelic) at the exact moment a 30-second timer claim fires.
expected: claimNow() waits for any in-flight user action to complete before calculating/adopting claim state, preventing the claim snapshot from clobbering the freshly crafted or equipped items.
actual: claimNow() only waited when snap.busy === 'fightBoss'. If busy was 'craft', 'salvage', or 'equip', claimNow() proceeded concurrently and adopt(result.state) could overwrite the updated inventory.

title: createEquipQueueV2 type signature prevents unequip calls
steps: Call equipQueue.current.equip(null, slot) to unequip gear.
expected: createEquipQueueV2 accepts itemId: string | null to match GameLoopV2.equip(itemId: string | null, slot).
actual: createEquipQueueV2 typed itemId strictly as string, blocking null unequip calls at compile time.
